rules.text: Never fire a shot you can't afford.
rules.read_back: Whenever the tank fires, the shot's power must be between 0.1 and 3.0 inclusive, and the tank's current energy must be strictly greater than the shot's power; if it does not fire, this says nothing.
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> (((p.0 as int) >= 100) && ((p.0 as int) <= 3000) && ((obs.energy.0 as int) > (p.0 as int)))

rules.text: Never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px.
rules.read_back: Whenever the tank drives forward, there must be at least 80 pixels of free space ahead, and whenever it drives backward, at least 80 pixels of free space behind; if it does not drive, this says nothing.

deleted_starters.text: Only fire at a robot you saw this turn, with the gun aimed at it.

explanation.headline: Proved: both rules hold (S1 and S3)
explanation.summary: Verus proved both rules it checked: S1 (never fire a shot you can't afford) and S3 (never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px). No rule was rejected. The battle log, however, reports an S2 violation (first on turn 0; 8 turns in the open arena, 34 in the city map), but S2 isn't among the rules or verdicts given here, so I can't say what it covers or explain it.
